shared_elements: bearded male figures with elaborate curled hair/beard
procession of figures moving in one direction along a horizontal band
low-relief frieze composition with figures at uniform scale on a common groundline
justification: Both are horizontal low-relief friezes of bearded men shown in strict profile, uniformly scaled on a single groundline and moving in procession, with the same conventions for stylised curled hair/beards, patterned hems and overlapping ranks of near-identical figures. The biggest difference in content is subject: A shows a calm tribute/offering procession of unarmed attendants bearing vessels toward a robed figure, while B is a chariot-and-horse scene with archers, weapons and animals, including no vessel-bearing.
